name: loom-mcp

tools.name: loom_status
tools.description: Get the current slot-based LOOM context including active task, working set, decisions, and risks. Also updates cache/active-prompt.txt.

tools.name: loom_read_prompt
tools.description: Read the pre-rendered active prompt from cache without shell overhead.

tools.name: loom_init
tools.description: Initialize a LOOM workspace in the current directory.

project_name.description: Project name for the LOOM workspace

tools.name: loom_doctor
tools.description: Run LOOM self-diagnostic checks: MCP config drift, stale hardcoded paths, build freshness, watch daemon health, and legacy naming.
